==English==

===Etymology 1===
{{etymon|en|id=at the bottom|:inh|enm:lāh|tree=1}}
{{root|en|ine-pro|*legʰ-}}
From {{inh|en|enm|lah}}, {{m|enm|loue}}, from {{der|en|non|lágr|t=low}}, from {{der|en|gem-pro|*lēgaz|t=low; flat}}, from {{m|gem-pro|*ligjaną|t=to lie; to lead}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*légʰyeti|t=to be lying down}}, from {{m|ine-pro|*legʰ-|t=to lie}}.
{{col-top|2|cog}}
Cognate with {{cog|sco|laich|t=low}}, {{cog|stq|läich|t=low}}, {{cog|fy|leech|t=low}}, {{cog|nl|laag|t=low}}, {{cog|nds-de|leeg}}, {{m|nds|leeg'|t=low; inferior}}, {{cog|vls|leeg|t=lazy}}, {{cog|da|lav|t=low}}, {{cog|fo,is|lágur|t=low}}, {{cog|nb,nn,sv|låg|t=low}}, {{cog|fi|laaka|t=flat}}, {{cog|izh|laaku|t=gentle}}; also {{cog|ga|laigh}}, {{m|ga|luigh|t=to lie}}, {{cog|gv|lhie|t=lie; lay}}, {{cog|gd|laigh|t=lie; lay}}, {{cog|xfa|𐌋𐌄𐌂𐌄𐌕|t=he lies down}}, {{cog|la|lectus|t=bed}}, {{cog|spx|𐌅𐌄𐌉𐌀𐌕|t=to lie}}, {{cog|grc|λέχομαι|t=to lie down}}, {{cog|sq|lag|t=band, encampment, troop}}, {{cog|be|ляжа́ць|t=to lie}}, {{cog|bg|лежа́|t=to lie}}, {{cog|cs|ležet|t=to lie}}, {{cog|mk|лежи|t=to lie}}, {{cog|pl|leżeć|t=to lie}}, {{cog|ru|лежа́ть|t=to lie}}, {{cog|sh|лѐжати}}, {{m|sh|lèžati|t=to lie}}, {{cog|sl|ležáti|t=to lie}}, {{cog|uk|лежа́ти|t=to lie}}, {{cog|txb|lyäk-|t=to lie}}. More at {{l|en|lie}}.
{{col-bottom}}

====Pronunciation====
* {{enPR|lō'''′'''}}
* {{a|en|UK}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈləʊ/|a=RP}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈlo/|a=Scotland}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈlou/|a=Wales,non-toe-tow}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈlaː/|a=Northumbria,dialectal}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈloʊ/|a=US}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-low.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈloʊ/|[ˈloː]|a=CA}}
* {{homophones|en|Lowe|;|lo<aa:toe-tow>}}
* {{rhymes|en|əʊ|s=1}}

====Adjective====
{{en-adj|er}}

# {{sid|en|close to ground}} Situated close to, or even below, the [[ground]] or another normal [[reference]] [[plane]]; not [[high]] or [[lofty]].
#: {{syn|en|nether|underslung}}
#: {{ant|en|high}}
#: {{ux|en|standing on '''low''' ground}} {{ux|en|in a '''low''' valley, ringed by low hills}} {{ux|en|a '''low''' wall  a '''low''' shelf}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2012|author=Tyler Jo Smith; Dimitris Plantzos|title=A Companion to Greek Art|isbn=1118273370
|passage=Narrative friezes in '''low''' relief were characteristic of Ionic architecture.}}
## {{sid|en|elevation}} Pertaining to (or, especially of a language: spoken in) in an area which is at a lesser elevation, closer to sea level (especially near the sea), than other regions.
##: {{ux|en|the '''low''' countries}}
##: {{ux|en|'''Low''' German}}
## {{sid|en|baseball}} {{lb|en|baseball|of a ball}} Below the batter's knees.
##: {{ux|en|the pitch (or: the ball) was '''low'''}}
# {{sid|en|below typical height}} Of less than normal height or upward extent or growth, or of greater than normal depth or recession; below the average or normal level from which elevation is measured.
#: {{syn|en|short|small|Thesaurus:short}}
#: {{ant|en|tall|Thesaurus:tall}}
#: {{ux|en|a '''low''' bow}} {{ux|en|a '''low''' tide}} {{ux|en|the Mississippi is unusually '''low''' right now}}
#*: It is a little low '''hearb''' {{...}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1795|author=James Cavanah Murphy|title=Travels in Portugal|page=15
|passage=The men are well-proportioned, rather '''low''' than tall, have a brown complexion, and reserved countenance.}}
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Rachel Ramirez and Hafsa Khalil|title=Antarctic ice shelf nearly the size of Los Angeles collapsed as temperatures soared to 40 above normal|url=https://www.cnn.com/2022/03/25/world/antarctic-conger-ice-shelf-collapse-climate/index.html|date=2022-03-25|passage=Just a month ago, data showed Antarctica would set a record this year for '''lowest''' sea-ice extent — the area of ocean covered by sea ice around the continent.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20250312102203/https://www.cnn.com/2022/03/25/world/antarctic-conger-ice-shelf-collapse-climate/index.html|archivedate=12 March 2025}}
## {{sid|en|low-cut}} [[low-cut|Low-cut]].
##* {{quote-book|en|year=1878|author=Mary Eliza Joy Haweis|title=The Art of Beauty|page=83|publisher=Chatto & Windus|location=London
|passage=Again, observe the unmeaningness of the low neck fashion. Our mothers wore '''low''' dresses and bare arms all day long; they knew if their shoulders and arms were beautiful they would look as well by daylight as by candlelight; {{...}}}}
##* {{quote-book|en|year=1917|author=George Amos Dorsey|title=Young Low|page=195
|passage=Why do girls wear '''low''' dresses?}}
# {{sid|en|status}} Not [[high]] in [[status]], [[esteem]]{{,}} or [[rank]], [[dignity]], or [[quality]]. {{q|Compare {{m|en|vulgar}}.}}
#: {{syn|en|bad|mid|sad|sorry|Thesaurus:low-quality}}
#: {{ux|en|'''low''' birth}} {{ux|en|'''low''' rank}} {{ux|en|the '''low''' officials of the bureaucracy}} {{ux|en|'''low'''-quality fabric}} {{ux|en|playing '''low''' tricks on them}} {{ux|en|a person of '''low''' mind}}
#: {{ux|en|Now that was '''low''' even for you!}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=1971|journal=Keystone Folklore Quarterly|volume=16|page=208
|passage=Therefore they must have been common in the 16th century also among the folk first of all not as a high festival food but rather as a '''low''' festival and Sunday food, if our experience proves accurate.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1720|title=The Delphick oracle|page=35
|passage=Low-Sunday, is the Sunday after Easter, and is so call'd, because it is a '''low''' Festival in Comparison of that Day whereon Christ arose from Death to Life again.}}
# {{sid|en|humble}} [[humble|Humble]], [[meek]], not [[haughty]].
#: {{syn|en|modest|self-effacing|Thesaurus:humble}}
# {{sid|en|disparaging}} {{cap|disparaging}}; assigning little value or excellence.
#: {{syn|en|contemptuous|sneerful|Thesaurus:disdainful}}
#: {{ux|en|She had a '''low''' opinion of cats. He took a '''low''' view of dogs.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1826|author=Ebenezer Erskine|title=The Whole Works of the Rev. Ebenezer Erskine|section=Sermon VII, page 103
|passage=The humble soul has '''low''' thoughts of his own person; as David, 'I am a worm, and no man.'}}
# {{sid|en|nadir}} Being a [[nadir]], a [[bottom]].
#: {{ux|en|the '''low''' point in her career}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2012|author=Faith Hartmann|title=Only a Fool Would Have Believed It in the First Place|isbn=1479735930
|passage=Virginia, for example, reached such a '''low''' point in her junior year that she briefly considered suicide [...]}}
# {{sid|en|dejected}} [[depressed|Depressed]] in mood, [[dejected]], [[sad]].
#: {{syn|en|sorrowful|unhappy|Thesaurus:sad}}
#: {{ux|en|'''low''' spirits}}
# {{sid|en|lacking health}} Lacking [[health]] or [[vitality]], [[strength]] or [[vivacity]]; [[feeble]]; [[weak]].
#: {{syn|en|anemic|frail|Thesaurus:weak}}
#: {{ux|en|a '''low''' pulse}}
#: {{ux|en|made (or: laid) '''low''' by sickness}}
## {{sid|en|few hit points}} {{lb|en|video games|roleplaying games}} Having few [[hit point]]s remaining; [[damaged]].
# {{sid|en|dead}} [[dead|Dead]]. {{q|Compare {{m|en|lay low}}.}}
#: {{syn|en|departed|six feet under|Thesaurus:dead}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1830|author=George Gordon Byron Baron Byron|title=Byron's Poems|page=511
|passage=And wilt thou weep when I am '''low'''?}}
#* {{RQ:Tennyson Wellington|stanza=III|page=6|passage=[L]et the mournful martial music blow; / The last great Englishman is '''low'''.}}
# {{sid|en|small quantity}} Small, not high (in amount or quantity, value, force, energy, etc).
#: {{syn|en|reduced|devalued|low-level|Thesaurus:small|Thesaurus:worthless}}
#: {{ux|en|My credit union charges a '''low''' interest rate.   Jogging during a [[whiteout]], with such '''low''' temperatures and '''low''' visibility, is dangerous.   The store sold bread at '''low''' prices, and milk at even '''lower''' prices.   The contractors gave a '''low''' estimate of the costs.   '''low''' cholesterol   a '''low''' voltage wire   a '''low''' number}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1989|author=Bernard Smith|title=Sailloons and Fliptackers: The Limits to High-speed Sailing|isbn=0930403657
|passage=Unfortunately, '''low''' winds were the rule over the local waters and this craft was no better, if as good, as ordinary sailboats under such conditions.}}
#* {{RQ:Economist|date=2013-06-22|volume=407| issue=8841| page=68| url=http://www.economist.com/news/finance-and-economics/21579860-g8-pledges-tackle-three-ts-t-time|title=T time| passage=The ability to shift profits to '''low'''-tax countries by locating intellectual property in them, which is then licensed to related businesses in high-tax countries, is often assumed to be the preserve of high-tech companies. […] current tax rules make it easy for all sorts of firms to generate […] “stateless income”: profit subject to tax in a jurisdiction that is neither the location of the factors of production that generate the income nor where the parent firm is domiciled.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170702223329/http://www.economist.com:80/news/finance-and-economics/21579860-g8-pledges-tackle-three-ts-t-time|archivedate=2 July 2017}}
## {{sid|en|small concentration}} Having a small or comparatively smaller concentration of (a substance, which is often but not always linked by "in" when predicative).
##: {{ux|en|diets '''low''' in vitamin A}}
##: {{ux|en|made from '''low'''-carbon steel}}
## {{sid|en|lacking in supply}} [[deplete|Depleted]], or nearing deletion; lacking in supply.
##: {{syn|en|expended|used up|Thesaurus:depleted}}
##: {{ux|en|running '''low''' on cash}}
# {{sid|en|simple in biological complexity}} {{lb|en|especially in|_|biology}} Simple in complexity or development.
#: {{ux|en|'''low''' protozoan animals, '''low''' cryptogamic plants, and other '''low''' organisms}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1870|author=Edward Burnett Tylor|title=Researches Into the Early History of Mankind and the Development of Civilization|page=80
|passage=In the case of languages spoken by very '''low''' races, like the Puris and the Tasmanians, the difficulty of deciding such a point must be very great.}}
# {{sid|en|favoring simplicity}} {{lb|en|chiefly|in several set phrases}} Favoring simplicity (see e.g. {{m|en|low church}}, Low Tory).
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1881|author=Anthony Trollope|title=Dr. Wortle's School: A Novel|page=6
|passage=Among them there was none more '''low''', more pious, more sincere, or more given to interference. To teach Mr. Worth his duty as a parish clergyman was evidently a necessity to such a bishop.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1889|author=Reginald Garton Wilberforce|title=Life of Samuel Wilberforce, Bishop of Oxford and Winchester|page=152
|passage={{...}} and give a judgment against not only Denison, but the Church's doctrine; and that, it having once been given, we shall not get it reversed; and that the Church of England will seem to be committed to '''Low''' doctrine, which {{...}}}}
# {{sid|en|near equator}} {{lb|en|in several set phrases}} Being near the [[equator]].
#: {{ux|en|the '''low''' northern latitudes}}
# {{sid|en|pitch}} {{lb|en|acoustics}} [[grave|Grave]] in pitch, due to being produced by relatively slow vibrations (wave oscillations); [[flat]].
#: {{syn|en|low-pitched|deep|flat}}
#: {{ux|en|The note was too '''low''' for her to sing.}}
#: {{ux|en|Generally, European men have '''lower''' voices than their Indian counterparts.}}
# {{sid|en|quiet}} [[quiet|Quiet]]; [[soft]]; not [[loud]].
#: {{syn|en|low-toned|soft|Thesaurus:quiet}}
#: {{ux|en|They spoke in '''low''' voices so I would not hear what they were saying.}}
#: {{ux|en|Why would you want to play heavy metal at such a '''low''' volume?}}
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Much Ado About Nothing|II|i|text=Speak '''low''' if you speak love.}}
# {{sid|en|phonetics}} {{lb|en|phonetics}} Made with a relatively large opening between the [[tongue]] and the [[palate]]; made with (part of) the tongue positioned low in the mouth, relative to the palate.
# {{sid|en|playing cards}} {{lb|en|card games}} Lesser in value than other cards, denominations, suits, etc.
#: {{ux|en|a '''low''' card}}
# {{sid|en|unseasoned}} {{lb|en|now|rare}} Not [[rich]] or [[seasoned]]; offering the minimum of nutritional requirements; [[plain]], [[simple]]. {{defdate|from 17th c.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1789|author={{w|John Moore (Scottish physician)|John Moore}}|title=Zeluco|publisher=Valancourt|year_published=2008|page=173
|passage=The Physicians ordered a '''low''' diet, and cooling ptisans in great abundance.}}
# {{sid|en|automobiles}} {{lb|en|of an|automobile, gear, etc}} Designed for a [[slow]] (or the slowest) [[speed]].
#: {{ux|en|'''low''' gear}}
